services.text: Services Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of its inputs against their own trailing 5-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. It was -23.3 at 31 July 2026, below its 5-year norm, down from -17.8 a month earlier and 15.3 six months earlier. QLD coal saleable tonnes is the largest negative contributor (-13.3), while ABS mining capex (actual) is the largest positive contributor (+2.3).

products.text: Products Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of its inputs against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100; its 29.9 reading at 31 August 2026 is above that norm. It has eased from 32.5 a month earlier but remains above its 9.3 three months ago and 14.3 six months ago, led by US new orders for iron and steel mills (+28.6) and offset most by inverted AUD/USD (-20.0). AISI raw-steel capacity utilisation and discontinued CAT retail-sales data are excluded from the score.

margin.text: Margin Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of fitter/welder vacancy tightness and AUD/USD against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. At -17.0 in August 2026, it is below its five-year norm; it has worsened from -10.8 a month earlier but improved from -23.7 three months earlier. AUD/USD is the largest negative contributor (-30.6), while fitter/welder vacancy tightness is the largest positive contributor (+13.6); tungsten policy flags are excluded pending sufficient history.

technology.text: The pipeline holds 2 leads, 3 agreements and 2 commissioned cells, with $2.4 million in stated contracted value and no stated recognised value. Over the past six months, it added 2 leads, 3 agreements and 2 commissioned cells, including the $2.4 million Komatsu licensing agreement and its first modular laser cell completing commissioning.
